name: Ubidots
tagline: IoT data visualization and analytics platform with REST for devices, variables, and dashboards.
description: Ubidots is an IoT platform that lets developers connect devices, store time-series data, and build dashboards. Its REST API covers devices, variables, values, events, and more for remote monitoring and automation.

auth.details: API token via X-Auth-Token header (or token query param); create tokens in account settings after signup.

use_cases: list IoT devices in an account
send telemetry data points to a device
query historical time-series data for a sensor
